title: Check a coding completion claim
objective: Combine semantic checks with deterministic checks of supplied test receipts; do not trust the agent saying done.

satisfies_requirement.instructions: Does `diff_summary`, together with the test evidence in `evidence`, support the stated `requirement`?

missing_required_test.instructions: Is a test required by `requirement` visibly missing from `evidence.test_summary`?

scope: Advisory decision workflow. No native Codex interception or production action.
